subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should this PR establish the Profile and Discovery Surfaces vocabulary now, including Official publisher, Public profile, and Public catalog labels, before the adjacent feed and publisher-state PRs settle?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the new spec and labels define durable trust/state language that adjacent open PRs are also shaping, so automation cannot safely choose the product vocabulary order.

options.title: Accept This Narrow Vocabulary Slice
options.body: Land this PR after browser proof, treating the label vocabulary as the baseline for later feed and state work.

options.title: Consolidate With Publisher State Work
options.body: Pause this PR until the adjacent publisher-state and feed drafts define the final vocabulary together.

options.title: Spec-Only First
options.body: Keep or land only the durable intent note and defer visible UI labels until backing state work is accepted.

recommendation.title: Accept This Narrow Vocabulary Slice
recommendation.body: Land this PR after browser proof, treating the label vocabulary as the baseline for later feed and state work.

likelyOwner.reason: The current official-publisher spec and UI copy history point to Patrick-Erichsen as the strongest available routing candidate for this vocabulary decision.
